title: Howl from Beyond
description:
Deal 18 damage to ALL enemies.
At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it.
upgraded_description:
Deal 24 damage to ALL enemies.
At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it.
notes: Automatically plays from the Exhaust Pile at the end of each turn.
